description: Uploads an encrypted file to a space and returns the blob reference to store in a sealed record.

main.description: Uploads an encrypted file to a space and returns the blob reference to store in a sealed record.

errors.name: BlobNotFound
errors.description: The space isn't the caller's own, answered exactly as for a missing blob.

errors.name: LengthRequired
errors.description: The request had no Content-Length header. The server holds the file's room against the quota before receiving anything, so it needs the length first.

errors.name: UploadStalled
errors.description: The client sent nothing for too long, so the server ended the upload and freed its place. Send the file again.

errors.name: BlobTooLarge
errors.description: The file is larger than the server accepts: 100 MiB on LogDate Cloud.

errors.name: QuotaExceeded
errors.description: The upload's Content-Length doesn't fit in what's left of the account's storage quota, counting other uploads in progress, or the file didn't fit once received. A file the space already holds adds nothing once stored.

errors.name: RateLimitExceeded
errors.description: The account sent too many requests of this kind recently. Wait the seconds in the Retry-After header, then retry. Record writes, reads and blob uploads are counted separately.

errors.name: ServerBusy
errors.description: The server is already moving as many files as it can hold. Wait the seconds in the Retry-After header, then retry. It isn't counted against the account.
